errors.evidence: The intervals on the x-axis are not uniform. The labels are for years 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2025, and 2030, which correspond to intervals of 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 4, and 5 years, respectively.
In 2010, the line starts at exactly 1200 USD/kWh, not approximately 1250 USD/kWh.
The value in 2014 is approximately 600 USD/kWh. The value of approximately 750 USD/kWh corresponds to the year 2012.
The value in 2018 is approximately 180 USD/kWh. The value of approximately 300 USD/kWh corresponds to the year 2016.
The value in 2025 is approximately 100 USD/kWh, not 200 USD/kWh.
In 2030, the line reaches a value of approximately 60-70 USD/kWh, which is significantly lower than 'a little over 150 USD/kWh'.
The description does not mention the legend, which labels the data series as 'Цена за USD/KWh'.
